text: A particle starts at a point O and moves along a straight line. Its velocity t s after leaving O is
(1.2t − 0.12t ) m s . Find the displacement of the particle from O when its acceleration is 0.6 m s .
A load is pulled along a horizontal straight track, from A to B, by a force of magnitude P N which
acts at an angle of 30 upwards from the horizontal. The distance AB is 80 m. The speed of the load
is constant and equal to 1.2 m s as it moves from A to the mid-point M of AB.
A ball moves on the horizontal surface of a billiards table with deceleration of constant magnitude
d m s . The ball starts at A with speed 1.4 m s and reaches the edge of the table at B, 1.2 s later,
Particles P and Q move on a line of greatest slope of a smooth inclined plane. P is released from rest
at a point O on the line and 2 s later passes through the point A with speed 3.5 m s .
